set.body:
PRD IO-3, E-5, APP-14. Total-ingest integration gate under EyeLink reliability epic bd-01M039NWZN0BNEDYHVXZFB29CQ.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every nonblank ASC physical line is accounted exactly once as a typed record, preserved unknown record, or rejected line with accumulated diagnostics.
- Every diagnostic carries source identity, one-based line number, bounded source excerpt, named operands, and user-facing message.
- Malformed numeric fields, contradictory layouts, truncated blocks, invalid event pairs, timestamp errors, excessive line sizes, unsupported modes, and failsafe-recovered anomalies are values, never throws or silent drops.
- Property/fuzz tests are deterministic and minimized regressions are retained.
- Whole-input and arbitrary-chunk executions produce identical records and diagnostics.
- The dedicated line-accounting and corruption court is green on JVM and Scala.js.
